name: Thaumaturgy (Path of Transmutation) — 1 Basic — Fortify the Solid Form

system.description: By spending a Mental Trait, the thaumaturge strengthens the atomic bonds of an object she can see, negating any Fragile Negative Trait it carries or allowing armor to withstand one additional Health Level of damage. The enhancement lasts for one scene. This path retests with the Occult Ability and functions upon any object within the thaumaturge's direct line of sight, though blood within a living body cannot be affected.
